{{Infobox auto}}

{{Spoiler}}

'''Canned golden apples''' are the secret preservation of the [[Golden Apple|golden apple]]. They heal {{Value|Canned Golden Apples|heals}} and grant {{EffectLink|Absorption}} {{Value|Canned Golden Apples|level|effect=Absorption}} for {{Value|Canned Golden Apples|duration|effect=Absorption}} and {{EffectLink|Regeneration}} {{Value|Canned Golden Apples|level|effect=Regeneration}} for {{Value|Canned Golden Apples|duration|effect=Regeneration}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/canned_golden_apples.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A [[Baked Golden Apple|baked golden apple]], sugar and a glass bottle. The recipe is secret and never enters the recipe book.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating them takes {{Value|Canned Golden Apples|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Canned Golden Apples|heals}} and gives Absorption {{Value|Canned Golden Apples|level|effect=Absorption}} (4 extra hearts) for {{Value|Canned Golden Apples|duration|effect=Absorption|format=clock}} and Regeneration {{Value|Canned Golden Apples|level|effect=Regeneration}} for {{Value|Canned Golden Apples|duration|effect=Regeneration|format=clock}}. It gives the glass bottle back when eaten. Making them grants ''Wait, you can make that?''
